title: KB_OPS_TEST_SPOOL lifts the inside-test guard without checking the spool is the test's own
goal: ql_deliver.inside_test stays True under KB_OPS_TEST_SPOOL=1 unless CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA names a directory outside the clone (the test's own spool), so an exported variable cannot send fixture rows to the clone's spool again; kb/_self/querylog.md names the variable. Found by the SP-6btkjg4l review.

run: import os,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');os.environ['PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST']='t';os.environ['KB_OPS_TEST_SPOOL']='1';os.environ.pop('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA',None);import ql_deliver;sys.exit(1 if not ql_deliver.inside_test() else 0)

import os,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import ql_deliver as q
e=os.environ
e['PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST']='t'
e['KB_OPS_TEST_SPOOL']='1'
e.pop('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA',None)
assert q.inside_test()
for p in (os.path.join(str(q.HOME),'_cache'),str(q.HOME)):
    e['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=p
    assert q.inside_test(),p
e['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=tempfile.mkdtemp()
assert not q.inside_test()
del e['KB_OPS_TEST_SPOOL']
assert q.inside_test()
